name: Web service
purpose: runs on somebody else's computer, so you reach it over the internet instead of installing it
note: A web service and a web client are easy to swap: the search engine is the service, the browser is the client that reaches it

name: Web client
purpose: fetches web pages itself, rather than being what pages are fetched from

name: Document program
purpose: makes or shows something that is meant to be read as pages

name: Message program
purpose: carries what one person writes to another person

name: System program
purpose: runs the machine and what is on it, rather than a task of yours

name: Decoder
purpose: turns a recorded or printed form back into what it stands for
note: The kinship is one nobody sees: a media player and a barcode scanner do the same thing to different marks

name: Hardware component
purpose: is a part inside a device and of no use on its own
note: This is the family whose members are also `part_of` a device — the two statements are both true and say different things
